ios.desc:
BiteCritic is your ultimate food discovery and reviewing platform, now available as a native iOS app. Find new restaurants, read authentic reviews, and share your own dining experiences with a vibrant community of food enthusiasts.

Key Features:
• Discover restaurants near you with powerful search and filtering options
• Read detailed reviews with high-quality food photos
• Create your own reviews with ratings, photos, and detailed descriptions
• Save your favorite restaurants for future visits
• Follow food critics and friends to see their latest reviews
• Get personalized restaurant recommendations based on your taste preferences
• Access your BiteCritic account across web and mobile seamlessly
• Offline access to recently viewed restaurants and reviews

Whether you're a casual diner looking for your next meal or a passionate foodie documenting your culinary adventures, BiteCritic helps you find and share extraordinary dining experiences.

Download BiteCritic today and join our community of food lovers!

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built BiteCritic ([App Store Link: https://apps.apple.com/ph/app/bitecritic/id6743010069]) because I was frustrated trying to find the best dish using platforms focused only on venues. It's tough to know what's actually good to eat at a specific restaurant, or where the absolute best version of that taco or ramen bowl is hiding.

BiteCritic flips this by focusing entirely on rating and discovering food based on taste. You can rate specific dishes, search for the best local versions of what you're craving (not just restaurants serving it), and see top-rated items on a restaurant's menu before you order.

The project is built as a monorepo using Next.js, NestJS, Prisma, and PostgreSQL, running entirely on Google Cloud. Current operating costs are around $60/month. We also support 7 languages.

You can access it from https://bitecritic.com

Would love to hear your feedback and answer any questions!

Thanks!
